text: Families see their balance in the client portal, and they can pay it there, old eVet bills included.
Tom owes eighty-five dollars, on an old eVet bill.
He has no card saved, so he enters one.
In Scout, the eVet bill on Tom's Financial tab shows paid, and his balance is zero.
If a family calls instead, take the payment here, like any other bill. The invoicing videos show how.
Or send a pay link by email or text, so they can pay it themselves.
The most common mistakes: telling a family an old eVet bill can't be paid online, and taking a phone payment without recording it on the bill.
Remember: every balance, eVet or Scout, can be paid in the portal, by phone, or with a pay link.
